title: Time Jump: 10:00 AM — EOP Level 2 Activated

fields.narration: Facilitator: It is now 10:00 AM. The situation has escalated. The Epi team’s line list has been corrupted, the IIS export file now includes 412 non-existent MMR doses with invalid lot numbers, and the Epi fax server has stopped receiving incoming reports. The North District Clinic is working on paper. The Epi team cannot validate case data. The public is receiving conflicting messages via social media and local news. The Departmental Operations Center (DOC) has been activated. The Emergency Operations Plan is now at Level 2. The Incident Commander must now formally authorize paper mode for essential functions. The IC must also decide whether to pause the IIS export and close the network to external access.
